title: Espaces stratifiés et voisinages côniques (ou : déploiement des espaces stratifiés) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: No genuine mathematical error is visible. The proposition is stated without proof.

Unproved step: that the X_0 recovered in X (gluing X̃_0 with the mapping cylinder of p|Ẋ_0 → Y_0) is again bordering, and that its collar is well defined. This needs the commuting of homotheties (condition c of the previous page) and the product form p_0×id_I. The required gluing argument is routine but omitted.
The phrase 'germe de structure con[ique]' is partly illegible. The intended object is the given germ of conical structure 𝒯, not a new symbol Σ.

ideas.what: Compatibility of a collar of a bordering subset with a conical neighbourhood of a stratum; stability under shrinking; symmetry when both are collars
ideas.modern_name: Compatible/commuting control data; corner structures (collars commuting at corners)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Thom (1969), Mather (1970) control data; Verona (1984); Cerf/Douady for corners
ideas.where_published: Only the programme is sketched, in Esquisse d'un programme §5–6 (dévissage of stratified structures)

ideas.what: Correspondence between compatible collars in X and compatible collar data on the unfolding (X̃, Ẋ, p) and on the stratum Y
ideas.modern_name: Unzipping/resolution of stratified spaces respects boundaries and corners (blow-up to manifolds with corners)

missed.claim: Grothendieck formulates the unfolding (déploiement) of a stratified space as data (X̃, Ẋ, collar, Y, p) and checks that compatible collars correspond to compatible corner data upstairs. This anticipates the 'unzipping' to manifolds with corners in Ayala–Francis–Tanaka and the resolution of Thom–Mather spaces used by Albin–Mazzeo et al. Those works do not cite these notes, but the content itself is standard.
missed.quote: les germes de structures cylindriques compatibles avec le germe de structure cônique ... correspondent aux systèmes (X̃_0, ε̃_{X̃_0}, Y_0, ε_{Y_0})
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is of historical interest: an independent early formulation, within tame topology, of the unfolding/unzipping functor and its compatibility with boundaries.

deep.surprise_reason: The page carries technical compatibility lemmas for collars and conical neighbourhoods in an unfolding construction. It is conceptually in line with later work on resolutions and unzipping, but routine for specialists and essentially equivalent to known control-data and corner formalisms.
transcription_corrections: 'germe de structure conn[?] Σ' should read roughly 'germe de structure cônique 𝒯 donné(e)'. Σ appears to be a misreading of the script T/𝒯.
'(X_0, Σ)' is likely '(X_0, E)', the cylindrical structure (bordering subset with its collar).
In the system, the stray brace in '(X̃_0, ε̃_{X̃_0}), Y_0, ε_{Y_0})' should be '(X̃_0, ε̃_{X̃_0}, Y_0, ε_{Y_0})'.
